candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s and gateway checkout 502s (~2s).
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time data; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order ReadTimeout and postgres.save_order DependencyUnavailable with pool size 5 and 0 idle, consistent with db-pool-exhaustion. Gateway metrics show 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2406ms. No counter-evidence observed; server-side pool metrics still needed to confirm.
missing_evidence: Postgres server metrics (active connections, max_connections, wait times) for the order service
Order service connection pool configuration and saturation metrics
Gateway logs (excluded) to confirm 502 cause mapping
